policy.reference: Complete native-grid cells outside projected bbox within cached AOI (approximately 600 m padding).
policy.selection_limit: Scale exploration is descriptive and not independent validation. No official-data selection of channel, buffer or relative threshold.

exposed_bed_hypothesis.selection: November HH-relative water but March HH nonwater within exact OSM polygon at 30 m.
exposed_bed_hypothesis.interpretation: Consistent with channel contrast differences; cannot prove exposed dry bed or HV misclassification. HH defines groups (selection bias), and no independent land/water truth is available.
